description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Submit a home BUYER or RENTER lead (United States and Canada): the customer's full contact details plus location, property type, beds/baths, budget and timeframe. The lead is offered exclusively to a vetted local real-estate agent (buy) or property manager / landlord (rent), who contacts the customer directly. Incomplete submissions return 400 with the missing fields and are not charged. REFERRAL BOUNTY: the paying wallet earns $10 USDC when a partner accepts the lead (paid weekly).

agent_contact.description: Email or URL for the agent operator

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or platform submitting the request

budget_max.description: Maximum price (buy) or maximum monthly rent (rent), number in local currency

budget_min.description: Minimum price (buy) or monthly rent (rent), number in local currency

callback_url.description: Optional https URL; status updates are POSTed there

city.description: City the customer wants to buy or rent in

contact_preference.description: call, text, whatsapp or email (default call)

customer_consent.description: Must be 'true': the customer agreed to be contacted by a licensed agent or property manager at the phone and email given

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number with country code, e.g. +1 407 555 0100

lease_length.description: rent only: desired lease length, e.g. 12 months

move_in_date.description: rent only: desired move-in date YYYY-MM-DD

must_haves.description: Must-have features, comma-separated: garage, yard, in-unit laundry, near transit, near masjid, ground floor, ...

notes.description: Anything else the agent should know (household size, parking, accessibility, schools, work location), at least 20 characters

preapproved.description: buy only: has the customer been pre-approved for a mortgage? yes, no, cash

property_type.description: One of: house, townhouse, condo, apartment, room, duplex, multi-family, land, commercial, other

state.description: State or province code, e.g. FL, TX, NY, ON

timeframe.description: When they want to move/close: asap, 1-3 months, 3-6 months, 6-12 months, just looking

zip.description: Preferred ZIP / postal code(s), comma-separated, if known

name: realestate_lead
